name: message-actions
title: Message Actions
description: The action row under an AI reply: vote, copy with a drawn check, react with an emoji bar and a searchable picker, reply, a more menu and a rolling timestamp, with one tooltip that follows the pointer.
label: AICSS by Kevin (kvnkld)
author: Kevin (kvnkld) <https://github.com/kvnkld>

loop.script: hover[0] → press[0] → release[0] → hover[2] → hover[3] → hover[4] → idle

props.name: text
props.description: The message text that Copy writes to the clipboard.

props.name: sentAt
props.description: When the message was sent: the row shows "3m ago" (rolling each minute) and the full date in a tooltip.

props.name: density
props.description: "compact" is upstream's 20px buttons. "comfortable" gives each button a 24px target (WCAG 2.2 target size) with the same look inside; the demo uses it.

props.name: onCopy / onVote / onReact
props.type: (text: string) => void / (vote: "up" | "down" | null) => void / (emoji: string | null) => void
props.description: Called after a copy, a vote (null when undone) and a reaction (null when removed).

props.name: onReply / onFork
props.description: Called by Reply and by Fork chat in the more menu.

props.name: icons
props.description: Replace any icon of the set with your own render function (good, bad, copy, copied, smile, reply, more, aloud, fork, report, search, addEmoji).

a11y: Every action is a labelled button; the votes are toggle buttons (aria-pressed) and the reaction and more buttons say whether their popup is open.
At the default compact density the 20px buttons sit closer than WCAG 2.2's 24px target size, as upstream's do; density="comfortable" meets it without changing the pill or icons (a Labs addition).
Tooltips open on hover and on keyboard focus, and are linked to their button with aria-describedby; the timestamp is focusable so its full date is reachable from the keyboard (a Labs addition).
The reactions open in a popover with a toolbar (arrow keys move between emoji, Escape closes and returns focus); the more actions are a real menu with arrow keys and typeahead.
A polite live region says "Copied" after a copy (a Labs addition).
Under prefers-reduced-motion the bumps, wink, draw-in, tooltip glide and popup scale are off.
